substitutions.title: Native bridge bootstrap
substitutions.summary: Rust workspace + @ruwanego/pi-native N-API loader exposing rustVersion(). Nothing in Pi depends on it yet.

substitutions.title: packages/protocol CBOR + framing
substitutions.summary: Rust CBOR subset + framing behind setNativeCodec(protocolCodec). The TypeScript codec stays the default; the protocol test suite runs against both, plus a differential fuzz suite.

benchmark.note: Rust/TS time ratio, linux-x64, Node 22.20; lower is faster. Decoding writes the structure as JSON for V8's JSON.parse and patches in byte strings and long strings; text encoding uses V8's UTF-8 writer. Copy-bound cases (decoding 1MB of ASCII text or bytes) are at parity because both sides must copy the data.

substitutions.title: coding-agent find
substitutions.summary: In-process Rust port of the fd search behind the find tool (ignore + globset, same settings, output and error text as fd) behind setNativeFind(findFiles). fd stays the default. Only difference: results are always sorted; fd sorts only searches that finish within 100 ms.

benchmark.note: native/fd time ratio for one find tool call (pattern *.ts, limit 1000), median of 25 warm calls, linux-x64 (WSL2, 22 CPUs), Node 22.20, fd 10.5.0; lower is faster. Searches start on one thread and switch to the parallel walker after 500 entries; trees that needed it start parallel next time.

substitutions.title: coding-agent grep
substitutions.summary: In-process Rust port of the ripgrep search behind the grep tool (ignore + grep-regex + grep-searcher with ripgrep 15's configuration: matcher options, binary detection, BOM sniffing, mmap choice, ignore files, --glob root, stderr messages and exit status) behind setNativeGrep(grepFiles); also enabled by PI_RUST=1. ripgrep stays the default. Differences: matching files are reported in path order, and RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH is not read.

benchmark.note: native/rg time ratio for one grep tool call (pattern export, limit 100), median of 25 warm calls, linux-x64 (WSL2, 22 CPUs), Node 22.20, ripgrep 15.2.0; lower is faster. Searches start on one thread and switch to the parallel walker after 250 entries; with context, the native search returns the context lines instead of the tool re-reading files.
